flipToBack.timing: Required singleton trigger on isTableChanged (standing state)
flipToBack.prose: Flips when owner CONTROLS Theed Palace Throne Room with a Neimoidian there AND CONTROLS Naboo system.

children.req: control WITH actor: owner controls Theed Palace Throne Room with a Neimoidian there

flipToFront.timing: Required singleton trigger on isTableChanged (standing state)
flipToFront.prose: Flips back to front when OPPONENT controls Naboo system OR Theed Palace Throne Room.

children.req: control by OPPONENT of either key location

requirementSemantics: Front flip leg 1 is CONTROL-WITH: controlsWith(Theed_Palace_Throne_Room, Neimoidian) = owner controls the site AND a Neimoidian of owner's is there (SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE). Occupation is not enough; opponent presence at the Throne Room breaks control.
Front flip leg 2 is plain CONTROL of Naboo system (controls, not occupies): requires owner presence and zero opponent presence at the system.
Back flip is opponent CONTROL (not mere presence) of EITHER Naboo system OR Theed Palace Throne Room: opponent presence alongside owner's does NOT flip it back; opponent must control outright.
Both checks use SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, so battle-excluded cards still count for control/with.
setupAndPullRoutes: Start of game deploys Naboo system with Blockade Flagship there (DeployCardToLocationFromReserveDeckEffect to Filters.Naboo_system), Naboo: Swamp, and Droid Racks from Reserve Deck (front:55-86).
Front pull: once during your deploy phase, deploy a Naboo site (Filters.Naboo_site) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (front:141-160).
No pulls/tutors coded on the back.
otherObligations: Front, remainder of game: may not deploy cards with ability except [Trade Federation] starships and characters with 'Trade Federation' in lore; no Dejarik-rules deploys (front:89-98).
Front, remainder of game: Civil Disorder is canceled (action proxy cancels on play and on table, front:100-136).
Front, while this side up: opponent's Force icons at Naboo system are canceled (CancelForceIconsModifier, front:163-169).
Back: you lose no more than 2 Force to any Force drain (LimitForceLossFromForceDrainModifier, BACK:55).
Back: draws two battle destiny if unable to otherwise during a battle at a site with two differently-titled [Presence] droids (or a [Presence] droid + a Neimoidian) (BACK:57-60).
Back: your droid starfighters immune to attrition < 3 (BACK:61).
Back: once per battle, if opponent just drew an Interrupt for battle destiny, may place that destiny card out of play (optional trigger, BACK:66-88).
Strategic note from law: after flipping, owner must DENY opponent control of both Naboo system and Theed Palace Throne Room; the Neimoidian is only needed to flip forward, not to stay flipped.

profileGaps: keyCharacterFilter is null; the Neimoidian requirement lives only in flipLocationRules/actorLocationRules (actorFilterKey 'Neimoidian'), so any consumer reading keyCharacterFilter alone misses the flip actor.

All flipLocationRules/actorLocationRules are phase 'preFlip'; there is no postFlip rule expressing the back's hold requirement (flip-back if opponent CONTROLS Naboo system OR Theed Palace Throne Room).
No representation that back-flip is opponent-CONTROL (not presence) - the guard semantics for defending the two locations after flip are absent.
